title: Te Reo o te Pūmau
intro: E maumaharatia ana tēnei tangata mō tōna whakaaro nui me tōna arataki, me te tuku tohutohu e whiti ana i ngā whakatipuranga. He tohu ā rātou kupu i te karakia me te hiranga o te mōhio ki ngā manaakitanga me ngā whakamātautau a te Atua. Whakakitea te tuakiri o tēnei wairua whakaute.
clues: Ehara ahau i te poropiti, engari kei roto i te Karaipiture Tapu toku whakaaro nui e ora tonu ana.
I arotahi taku kupu tohutohu ki taku tamaiti ki te whakawhetai ki a Allah me te karo i te mahi tinihanga.
I whakaako ahau i te hiranga o te inoi, te whakahau i te pai, me te aukati i te kino.
I whakatūpato ahau kia kaua e whakapehapeha, e haereere whakahihi hoki i runga i te whenua.
Kua tapaina tōku ingoa ki tētahi upoko katoa o te Quran, e whakaatu ana i aku whakaakoranga.
I roto i taku tohutohu ko te manawanui i roto i te raruraru, he pono hoki, nō te tangata tino pakari tēnā.

trial.label: Te Whakaako/Aratohu Matua

Te tuku whakaaro nui me ngā tohutohu matatika
Te ārahi i tētahi iwi ki te wikitoria
trial.answer: Te tuku whakaaro nui me ngā tohutohu matatika

location.answer: He tohutohu whakaaro nui ki tētahi uri

options: I tuhia tōna whakaaro nui ki roto i te Quran

outcome.answer: I tuhia tōna whakaaro nui ki roto i te Quran

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
